comment: Geography for one chokepoint + its LNG terminals. Adding a second strait/terminal set is a new config of this shape plus a fleet registry - not a code change. All boxes are [lat, lon] pairs (the Open Waters order). Crossing zones: a fix inside band_lat and at/west of west_lon is definitively Gulf side; at/east of east_lon definitively Oman side; between them is the strait buffer. Crossing time is interpolated at line_lon.
